meta.name: qa
meta.description: Exercise the delivered customer journey using real runtime or browser evidence. Use for functional acceptance testing after implementation, including failure paths.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把交付的功能真实跑一遍,连失败路径也一起验证
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果功能刚做完,想知道真实使用中会不会出问题
copy.tagline_en: Run the delivered journey for real and verify it, failure paths included
copy.fit_line_en: For you if the feature is just built and you want proof it works in real use

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用真实运行环境或浏览器的证据，把已交付的客户流程实际跑一遍，做功能验收测试，并覆盖失败路径。它会如实报告缺失的能力或没跑的检查。
howto.when: 实现完成之后需要做功能验收测试时触发，包括失败路径的验证；被 @fde 调用时复用它的当前范围，不重新做设置或重复提问。

say.text: 跑一遍已交付客户流程的功能验收测试，包括失败路径。
say.note: 按真实运行或浏览器证据走查流程

say.text: 用浏览器证据验证这个功能是否真的可用。
say.note: 输出基于实际运行的验收结果

say.text: @fde 复用当前范围，直接开始功能验收。
say.note: 不重开设置，沿用已有范围

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude exercises the delivered customer journey using real runtime or browser evidence — functional acceptance testing after implementation, including failure paths. It honestly reports missing capabilities or checks it did not run.
howto.when_en: Triggered when functional acceptance testing is needed after implementation, including failure paths; when called by @fde it reuses that scope without restarting setup or re-asking answered questions.

say_en.text: Run functional acceptance testing on the delivered customer journey, including failure paths.
say_en.note: Walks the journey with real runtime or browser evidence

say_en.text: Verify this feature with browser evidence to confirm it actually works.
say_en.note: Reports acceptance results from real runs

say_en.text: @fde reuse the current scope and start functional acceptance.
say_en.note: No restart of setup; keeps existing scope
